einzeiler: Peter Sagal and panel tackle the week's news with fashion designer Daniel Vasovic.
kurzfassung: Peter Sagal hosts the NPR news quiz with panelists Rachel Koster, Shantira Jackson, and Peter Gross. Contestants test their news knowledge through quote identification and bluff games. Fashion designer Daniel Vasovic joins the show for an interview and a game about airport tarmacs.
stichpunkte: A listener named Jen plays the news quiz, correctly identifying stories about political rallies, food delivery robots, and pumpkin skincare.
The panel discusses a debate over whether cats walking on kitchen counters are unhygienic.
Laura plays the Bluff the Listener game and successfully identifies a news story about feuding gas stations.
Fashion designer Daniel Vasovic discusses his path from gymnastics to fashion and his time working at a mall store.
Daniel plays a game called Project Runway meet Project Tarmac, guessing unusual airport stories.
The panel explores new dating trends, including fitness enthusiasts sharing their resting heart rates.
Contestants participate in the Limerick Challenge featuring topics like Pringles urns and Olympic yoga.
Peter Gross wins the final Lightning Fill-in-the-Blank round.

clips.hook: A very low resting heart rate could mean you're currently in a coma
clips.text: Dating app users sharing their resting heart rates might accidentally signal fitness or medical emergencies.

clips.hook: An emergency landing because a woman couldn't open the bathroom door
clips.text: An airline flight had to be diverted after a passenger became trapped inside the aircraft restroom.

beschreibung:
This week, we’re live in Kalamazoo with fashion designer and Project Runway alum Daniel Vosovic. Plus, panelists Rachel Coster, Peter Grosz, and Shantira Jackson talk beautiful butts, suspicious robots, and well-preserved pumpkins.
